title: The Grand Inquisitor
description: The imposing Pau'an known only as the Grand Inquisitor was the leader of the Empire's elite cadre of Jedi hunters known as the Inquisitorius. Tasked with tracking down and killing Jedi on the run and other Force-sensitives, the Grand Inquisitor wielded an intimidating, spinning double-bladed Lightsaber. No Jedi was safe from the Grand Inquisitor's piercing gaze.
